title: N.C.R.B., (M.H.A.) CRIME IN INDIA - 1995 9.3.2 At the national level, the Scheduled Castes constituted 16.3 per cent of the total population while the Scheduled Tribes constituted only 8.0 per cent. Uttar Pradesh with a share of 16.4 per cent towards country's population also had the highest share (21.2%) towards Scheduled Caste population in the country. Madhya Pradesh, which was the sixth densely populated State in the country had the highest (22.7%) tribal (STs) population.
